description: Search LinkedIn job postings. Useful for tracking hiring signals at target companies. Costs 5 credits per call.

companyId.description: Restrict to a LinkedIn company ID (numeric, e.g. '1441'). Not a name or slug — resolve one first with linkedin_company_search, which returns each company's id.

postedLimit.description: Only jobs posted within this window.

refresh.description: Bypass the cache and re-run the search live (costs 5 credits). Default false: a previously-fetched result is returned free, with how long ago it was retrieved.

sortBy.description: Sort order. 'date' is the useful one for hiring signal. Default: relevance.

name: linkedin_job_search
title: LinkedIn Job Search
